policy.retention: Within every affected net, retain complete old branches exactly when both RR source and sink endpoints are unchanged
policy.source_move: Remapped source invalidates all of that net's old branches
policy.resource_accounting: Unaffected base reservations plus explicit per-net dynamic owner sets, counted once per net; support capacity > 1
policy.versions: Retained route versions stay unchanged; resources conservatively version the full affected-net union
policy.congestion: Retained trees remain fixed across bounded negotiation; no implicit full-tree fallback
policy.ordering: Same task priority/id and net wave ordering for empty-tree and retained-tree controls
policy.kernel: Existing PR HBM C-model search/commit kernels with shared numeric guard
policy.acceptance: Strict native (wirelength, CPD) lexicographic improvement; both at most 102% of initial legal baseline

required_checks: Empty-tree control reproduces PR event semantics and search counts
Retained connection IDs exactly match unchanged endpoints
Every retained path and route version remain unchanged
Native legality and STA for every routed candidate
All rejected work and validation costs included
repeats: ex5p pilot: 1; fixed-policy development validation: 2 per design
limits: Do not infer native delay preservation from path preservation because RC branch loads can change
Do not compare later diverged candidate placements as matched per-candidate work
Best placer + PR baseline remains outstanding
